method: src/engine/timeline/signals.null.test.ts: 45-day simulated diaries, 15% of days unanswered, a medicine started 16 days ago, no real effect. Independent: every day drawn afresh. Clustered: each item repeats yesterday's answer with probability `stay`, otherwise it is drawn from the same base rate (same long-run rates). Rates are the share of simulated changes with at least one moderate-or-strong signal (moderateRate), at least one strong signal (strongRate), or any weak-or-stronger difference. Each row uses n = 1,000 simulated changes, so it is noisier than the 8,000-change figures in rules.ts and docs/EVALUATION.md (e.g. independent strongRate 0.003 = 3 of 1,000 vs about 0.8% with 8,000; the app's 'about 1 in 100' rounds the 8,000-change figure). stay values are assumed levels of clustering, not measured from real diaries.
